name: carousel-generator
description: Instagram carousel generator with nested block JSON, brand kits, assets and visual editor
long_description: Generates editable Instagram carousels as HTML and persists descriptive nested carousel.json documents with per-company assets. Includes a block editor with inline drag/reorder, golden-ratio calibration, multi brand-kit support, logo images, and PNG/PDF export.

tools.name: generate_carousel
tools.description: Generates and opens editable HTML, persisting nested carousel.json and assets by company

tools.name: list_carousels
tools.description: Lists persisted carousels grouped by company

tools.name: load_carousel
tools.description: Loads a persisted nested carousel, hydrates assets and opens editable HTML

tools.name: save_carousel
tools.description: Creates or updates nested carousel JSON and its asset folder

tools.name: delete_carousel
tools.description: Deletes a persisted carousel and its assets (two-step with confirm)

tools.name: review_slide_images
tools.description: Audits photos per slide with photoNeeds and suggested queries

tools.name: set_slide_photo
tools.description: Replaces the background photo of one slide from a URL or local file

tools.name: edit_slide
tools.description: Edits a slide: update_text, move, duplicate or delete without touching raw JSON

tools.name: set_slide_bg
tools.description: Cambia el fondo de una slide persistida sin foto: gradiente del kit (por nombre), CSS custom, o remove (vuelve al primer gradiente del kit y limpia scrim/ove…

tools.name: set_carousel_meta
tools.description: Actualiza meta de un carrusel persistido sin tocar las slides: title, format (feed|square|story + canvas), category (cascade de highlightColors) y showCount.

tools.name: validate_carousel
tools.description: Dry-run de calidad sobre un carrusel persistido (o slides sueltas sin guardar): narrativeAudit (cover/cta/figuras/kickers/orphans) + styleWarnings (raya larg…

tools.name: save_brand_kit
tools.description: Saves a brand kit JSON for reuse with generate_carousel

tools.name: load_brand_kit
tools.description: Returns the full JSON of a saved brand kit

tools.name: brand_kit_from_url
tools.description: Generates and saves a brand kit from a website URL (homepage heuristics), with per-field confidence for agent review

tools.name: carousel_from_url
tools.description: Builds a draft carousel from an article/note URL, with photos assigned from the article

tools.name: import_editor_state
tools.description: Imports editor Push JSON (or a v2 carousel) back into carousel.json, copying base64 photos to assets

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: Renders carousel slides to real PNGs with Chrome headless (formats 4:5/1:1/9:16, all or selected slides)

tools.name: social_copy
tools.description: Generates social captions, hooks, hashtags and per-slide alt text (es-AR heuristics, source.md → slides → meta)
